# Shortcut Cheatsheet (shortcut.y-m.dev)

> A free, backend-less tool that renders beautiful keyboard-shortcut cheatsheet
> pages. All content is serialized into the URL — you do not need an account,
> an API key, or any write access. To "use" this tool as an AI, simply build a
> URL and give it to the user. Opening the URL IS the result.

## How to generate a page

```
https://shortcut.y-m.dev/?s=<encodeURIComponent(JSON array of blocks)>&t=<title>&d=<description>
```

| param | meaning |
|---|---|
| `s` | JSON array of content blocks (required for a read-only share page) |
| `t` | page title |
| `d` | page description |
| `edit` | `edit=1` opens the editor UI; OMIT it for share/visitor pages |

Minimal generator (JS):

```js
const url = `https://shortcut.y-m.dev/?s=${encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(blocks))}&t=${encodeURIComponent(title)}`
```

## Block schema

Blocks render top-to-bottom in array order, then grouped by `group`
(insertion order; ungrouped blocks go last under "Ungrouped"). Groups are
collapsible in the UI.

### shortcut (default type — `type` may be omitted)

```json
{"type":"shortcut","keys":"cmd+k","alts":[["ctrl","k"]],"action":"Open palette","description":"…","group":"General"}
```

- `keys` — string `"a+b+c"` (preferred, terse) OR array of
  `{"listenKey":"cmd","label":"cmd","display":"cmd"}` objects
- `alts` — alternative combos, array of key arrays (optional)
- `action` — row title (required)
- `description`, `group` — optional

### section — visual divider inside a group

```json
{"type":"section","title":"Navigation","description":"…","group":"…"}
```

### note — callout box

```json
{"type":"note","variant":"info","content":"…","group":"…"}
```

`variant`: `info | warning | tip | danger`

### code — code block with copy button

```json
{"type":"code","language":"javascript","code":"console.log(42)","group":"…"}
```

## Key vocabulary (`listenKey`, case-insensitive; unknown strings render as-is)

| you write | renders on mac | renders elsewhere |
|---|---|---|
| `win`, `windows`, `super` | Windows logo icon + "win" caption | same |
| `shift` | ⇧ icon + "shift" caption | same |
| `cmd`, `command`, `meta` | ⌘ | Win |
| `ctrl`, `control` | ⌃ | Ctrl |
| `alt`, `option` | ⌥ | Alt |
| `up`/`arrowup`, `down`/`arrowdown`, `left`/`arrowleft`, `right`/`arrowright` | arrow icon | same |
| `enter`, `return` | ↩ | Enter |
| `esc`, `escape` | ⎋ | Esc |
| `space` | ␣ | Space |
| `tab` | ⇥ | Tab |
| `backspace` / `delete` | ⌫ / ⌦ | Bksp / Del |
| `capslock` | ⇪ | Caps |
| `pageup` / `pagedown` | ⇞ / ⇟ | PgUp / PgDn |
| `home` / `end` | ↖ / ↘ | Home / End |
| any other string (`k`, `/`, `[`, `f5`…) | raw text | raw text |

Important: `win` means the LITERAL Windows key (always the logo icon). For the
platform modifier (⌘ on macOS viewers), use `cmd`/`meta`.

## Visitor features (worth mentioning when sharing a page)

- Test mode: pressing the real keys highlights the matching key caps and combos
- Groups expand/collapse via chevron or group name
- Two-column grid on desktop AND mobile; list/grid toggle
- Light/dark theme; `?t=`/`?d=` custom title/description

## Worked example

```js
const blocks = [
  {"keys":"win+p","action":"投影模式"},
  {"keys":"win+k","action":"链接投屏"},
  {"keys":"/","action":"现场搜索经文","group":"信义PPT"},
  {"keys":"shift+r","action":"刷新PPT","description":"PPT 内拉取最新信息","group":"信义PPT"},
  {"type":"note","variant":"tip","content":"shift+g 展开/收起全部","group":"信义PPT"},
]
const url = "https://shortcut.y-m.dev/?s=" + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(blocks))
  + "&t=" + encodeURIComponent("信义PPT指南")
// → https://shortcut.y-m.dev/?s=%5B%7B%22keys%22%3A%22win%2Bp%22...&t=...
```

## Updating an existing page

Given a URL containing `?s=`, `decodeURIComponent` + `JSON.parse` the param,
edit the blocks array, re-encode, and rebuild the URL. To rename a group,
change `group` on every block that has it.
